title: 建立只读投影并接入 Chat 与导出

originalAcceptance.criterion: 至少一个普通 Chat 和一个显式 Task Loop 的投影可在 UI 与导出中回读。
JSONL 含 run/turn/item/approval/file/test/verification 类型或有明确映射说明。
相关 Electron E2E 与单测通过。

boundaries: The export is an in-memory JSONL text projection; no file write, host route or persistence was added.
Session keys are associations only; scope and lineage still require the existing owner.
Task Loop evidence gate is displayed as unavailable when absent and is never upgraded to a pass.
All receipts are agent-driven; no real-human evidence is claimed.
